summary: Retested the iteration-2 fixes through 31 backend API tests and desktop/mobile Playwright flows. All 29 targeted/core regression tests passed: malformed and missing IDs now return 404, failed default-address updates preserve the existing default, missing order status updates return 404, checkout auth is actionable, Sonner status toast appears, and mobile navigation is usable. Two previously-known out-of-scope auth security checks still fail.

critical.issue: Credentialed responses still return Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * rather than the explicit request origin while Access-Control-Allow-Credentials is true.
No brute-force lockout: six consecutive invalid-password attempts all returned 400; no 429 occurred after five failures.

action_items: When security scope permits, implement five-attempt login throttling/lockout.
Configure an explicit CORS allowlist instead of wildcard origin for credentialed requests.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js remains 1,896 lines, far above the 700-line maintainability threshold; split auth, navigation, catalog, checkout, orders, and footer into focused components/hooks.
Frontend product and user-data API failures are silently swallowed, which can leave mock/stale UI without an actionable error state.
Auth/address/order models remain largely unconstrained and order creation trusts client-supplied items and monetary totals; add structured validation and server-side total calculation.
seed_admin still falls back to hardcoded admin credentials rather than failing fast on missing ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD.

Verified Mongo safeguards: admin hash begins with $2b$, users.email has a unique index, and seed_admin updates an existing hash when the configured password changes. Login cookies are Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite=None.
seed_data_creation: Backend regression runs created TEST_ users and TEST orders because user/order deletion APIs do not exist; address fixtures were removed. UI E2E created testuser+ui3-1785507026@example.com with one address and one COD order. The admin-toast test changed a TEST order temporarily and restored its original Cancelled status.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Confirmed 404 behavior for malformed product GET/DELETE, address DELETE/default PATCH, and order GET/status PATCH/cancel; a valid nonexistent order status ID returns 404. Confirmed bogus/foreign address default requests preserve the user's existing default. Core auth, product search/suggest, scoped address CRUD, order create/mine/timeline/cancel, and admin RBAC/status persistence all pass. Frontend passed desktop search+See all, unauthenticated checkout auth layering, manual AddressPicker save, COD placement, five-stage order timeline, admin success toast within 3 seconds, and 390x844 guest/authenticated navbar visibility and clipping checks.
rca_of_the_issue: The targeted defects are fixed by centralized guarded ObjectId conversion, ownership verification before clearing defaults, checking Mongo matched_count, mounting Sonner Toaster, closing/elevating the cart/auth layers, and responsive mobile navbar changes. Remaining failures are caused by wildcard CORS configuration and absence of login-attempt tracking/throttling.
